title.narrative: UNICEF supported the creation of national legislation to enhance child protection in Bolivia, in collaboration with the Plurinational Legislative Assembly, the Ministry of Justice, and the Child Protection Office. This legislation upholds the right of children to live in a family, reducing the risk of family separation and unnecessary institutionalization.;

Extent of legal prohibition of corporal punishment of children in all settings
Extent to which the country has a national legislation to eliminate the worst forms of child labour
